Joyful Shots for the Day. 🕯️

Nothing is wasted — everything has its moment. ✨

Sometimes something doesn't work the first time, but that doesn't mean it's useless. Every effort, every try, every "failed" attempt is just waiting for the right moment to matter.

🪔 Think about it — you try to light a matchstick and it doesn't catch. You use another one to get the flame going. But then that first matchstick? You use it to carry the flame to the candle. It didn't fail — it was just waiting for its turn! 😊 Nothing you've tried is ever truly wasted.

Question: Is there something in your life right now that you gave up on too soon — that might actually still have a role to play if you stay flexible? 🤔

We Luv u. Joyful Team. ❤️
